text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It seems a great many people have
turned out to
root for me today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And that reporter who often writes
about me is
among them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: 今の君を見てもらおう！
今の貴方を見てもらおう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show everyone who you are right now!
Let's show them what you're made of right now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My determination and steadfast
progress... I'll
show them all what I can
do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ready to go, Grass Wonder leaves the
waiting
room beaming with energy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe. Let's have a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so glad I ran into you before the
race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow... Spe, you're stiff as a board.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Remember, only those recognized and
elected by
the fans are able to run in the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Plenty of people have come here to
support you
today, so why not take
pride in that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha... Yeah, I do really appreciate
their
support.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But, with you and the others here, I feel
like I'm
so, so out of my league.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's that time already! We have to
go!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's both go out there and give it
our all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You can accomplish anything if you put
your mind
to it. But you'll accomplish
nothing if you don't
try.
